description: This file declares the StateTransitionHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages state transition requests, providing methods for initialization, termination, adding requests, and singleton access. It includes references to external classes ApplicationContext and StateTransitionRequest.

classes.name: StateTransitionHandler
classes.description: Manages state transition requests, implements singleton pattern, and provides lifecycle methods.

methods.name: StateTransitionHandler(const StateTransitionHandler& obj)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent copying.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the handler.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a state transition request to the handler.
